method: marker search of the raw local capture (request body, response body, and URL). Sanitized network logs are not searched.
scope: Markers come from the fictional synthetic baby profile. A match in a request body or URL proves the entered value left the device. The committed, sanitized network logs are not searched because their bodies are redacted.

apps.claim_limit: not observed in this capture window under marker search of the raw file. This does not prove the app never sends the value.
